messages:
arjun: Evening deploy briefing — quick heads up: we're doing a capacity rebalance tonight. Non-critical canaries will be throttled between 22:00-23:00 PT to free burst for the Dedicated cutover. If you have an active canary/rollout, please pause or mark as low-priority. Ack if you see this.

lucy: Ack. Pausing embeddings canary now, will resume ~23:05 PT.

marta: Thanks. @arjun — does this touch tokenizer-v2 canary?

arjun: Tokenizer-v2 is high-priority and will NOT be throttled. This applies to canaries with `canary.priority=low` only. Use `--priority=high` or set rollout metadata if you need it exempted.

ops-bot: Scheduled throttle job queued: job_id=tb-2026-03-23-01. Enforcing rate limit 50% on group=noncritical-canaries at 22:00 PT.

david: Quick Q — will this affect EU region or just us-west?

arjun: Short answer: only us-west cluster for this rebalance. EU and apac clusters unchanged. If you see cross-region impact, ping #eng-oncall immediately.

sre-oncall: Monitoring dashboards bumped to high frequency and alert thresholds lowered. I'll post anomalies here if anything spikes :mag_right:.

lucy: Copying the pause command I ran in case it's useful:
```bash
redwood rollout pause --id rollout_1234
```

marta: :thumbsup: thanks, team.

arjun: If anyone needs an exception, DM me and cc @product-ops. We'll reopen full capacity at 23:00 PT and give a 10-minute grace window for resumed rollouts. Cheers.
